triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The registered red test exits 0 after promoteDist validates and restores staging bin targets before old-dist eviction: POSIX targets gain executable mode bits, while Windows preserves the byte-identical Node entrypoint used by npm command shims. Doctor reports the resolved global core through a host-independent passing marker and emits POSIX- or cmd.exe-valid remediation. The recorded RED run keeps the unfixed baseline discriminated.

note: B-e256 cross-platform ProofStory contract: stable machine selectors bind staging restoration and the resolved doctor pass state without host paths or universal POSIX mode promises.
